beats.narration: Noise-canceling headphones do not block sound. They listen to it first, then answer with a wave built to erase it.
beats.claim: active noise cancellation erases noise by playing its inverse, not by blocking it
beats.visual_question: how does a cup of plastic erase sound?
beats.visual_answer: a headphone cross-section where anti-noise meets incoming noise

beats.narration: A microphone outside the earcup samples the incoming noise, and a chip computes its mirror image: every crest flipped into a trough, one hundred eighty degrees out of phase.
beats.claim: the control system inverts the noise waveform 180 degrees
beats.visual_question: what does the chip actually build?
beats.visual_answer: the noise wave flipped upside down, crest to trough

beats.narration: The driver plays that anti-noise at the same moment the real noise arrives. Crest meets trough, and the two waves cancel to still air.
beats.claim: superposition of a wave and its inverse cancels the pressure wave
beats.visual_question: what happens when the two waves meet?
beats.visual_answer: overlapping waves summing flat: destructive interference

beats.narration: But cancellation is strongest where noise is simplest. Low rumbles are long and predictable, and they die easily. High hiss is short and scattered, and it gets through.
beats.claim: ANC attenuation is strongest at low frequencies and weakens as frequency rises
beats.visual_answer: a frequency band where cancellation fades with rising pitch

beats.narration: And the noise never sits still. Wind, engines, your own footsteps. So a second microphone inside the cup re-checks what is left, and the correction runs without pause.
beats.claim: closed-loop feedback continuously re-corrects residual noise
beats.visual_answer: an inner mic feeding the residual back into the chip

beats.narration: Two waves, one silence. Noise minus noise: engine drone drops by 30 decibels.
beats.claim: ANC reduces low-frequency noise on the order of 30 decibels
beats.visual_question: so what did the two waves buy?
beats.visual_answer: roughly thirty decibels of quiet, made of inverted sound
